description: f16 [2, 3]: rounding, the largest f16, overflow to inf, double rounding, the smallest normal f16.
notes: Float values are rounded from f64 to f32 and then to f16/bf16, as PyTorch does: 1.0004882812509095 gives 1.0 in f16 (one rounding from f64 would give 1.0009765625). A finite value beyond the dtype's range rounds to inf (IEEE 754), as in torch.tensor; torch.full and F.pad raise for it instead, so only this op has a fixture for it.
